newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SLALOM WINNER REITER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SLALOM WINNER REITER.

text.p: Brief profile of Mario Reiter, winner of a men's World Cup slalom on Sunday:
Overall World Cup wins: 3 -- Slalom: Sestriere (96), Kitzbuehel (97). Giant slalom: Furano (95)

Other feats - The 1996 world championships silver medalist only joined Austria's elite team at the late age of 21. He was kicked out of all Austrian ski squads at 19 after tearing his left cruciate ligament twice, but fought back and paid for his independent training by taking a job on a farm. His maiden victory at a giant slalom in Furano earned him the nickname "Super Mario" in the Austrian press. Had a slow start to the winter due to health problems. His victory in Kitzbuehel qualified him for the world championships in Sestriere, starting next Sunday.
